description:
Spec-only ball. Pin the tool-contract gaps in ARCH §3.3 (and §3.2 for the 'tool executor' component) so implementation balls #2-#6 have an unambiguous shape to code against.

=== Decisions to pin ===

- CLI surface for tools. §3.3 says 'in-process tools are implemented as built-in subcommands invoked the same way as external tools' but doesn't name the shape. Decide: in-process → 'lernie tool <name>' subcommand; external → 'lernie-tool-<name>' on PATH (mirrors §4.4's provider adapters). Confirm or propose alternative.
- Stdio contract for a tool invocation. JSON argument payload: argv vs stdin? Output: free-form bytes on stdout vs structured wrapper? Exit code semantics? SIGTERM deadline (mirror §4.4's 5s)?
- Tool-call commit shape. ARCH §2.3 says the step dir is extended with 'tool_calls/<tool-id>/…' but does not pin: (a) one commit per tool_call or one batched commit for all tool_calls in a step; (b) which files land (input, stdout, stderr, exit, timing?); (c) whether the next step's request.json commit (§2.10) is the commit that frames the tool_result blocks, or whether tool_calls have their own structural role.
- 'tools: [...]' request-field assembly. Where does the list of available tools come from in v0.3 (agents.yaml? a per-role field? an enumerated hardcode?), and how are schemas loaded from disk into the list the harness sends to the provider each step?
- Tool executor responsibilities (§3.2 names the role but doesn't describe it). Pin: ownership of tool subprocess lifecycle; atomic stdout capture (temp + rename per §3.3); SIGTERM cascade; the fact that v0.3 does NOT implement oversized-output auto-dispatch (non-goal per this epic) and §3.3 must reflect that explicitly rather than quietly drop the bullet.

=== Deliverable ===

PR on an ex/... branch touching docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (§3.2, §3.3, §2.3, §12 v0.3) and TAXONOMY.md / PRINCIPLES.md as needed for any new terms of art (flag any before introducing). No code.

=== Out of scope ===

- Handle-based async dispatch (v0.4).
- Oversized-output auto-dispatch (deferred from v0.3 per epic).
- Sub-agent dispatch tool (v0.4).
title: v0.3 tool contract: pin ARCH §3.3 gaps
